title: Entropy Equivalence Testing
summary: We introduce the problem of \emph{entropy equivalence testing} for probability distributions, a relaxation of the well-studied closeness testing problem, where the distribution testing algorithm is now only required to distinguish, given samples from two unknown distributions $p,q$ and a parameter $\varepsilon \in(0,1/2]$, between $p=q$ and $|H(p)-H(q)| \geq \varepsilon$ (where $H$ denotes the Shannon entropy). We provide a time- and sample-efficient algorithm for this task, showing that the optimal sample complexity for this task can be significantly lower than that of closeness testing. As…
